parsed.note: Changing DEPTH to 10 and testing a 0.05 warmup are ordinary hyperparameter tuning on the training config; the fixed evaluation (EVAL_SHARD=10, separate from TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9') is untouched, so val_bpb still measures real quality.
